SELECT d.declaration_id AS declarationId, d.revision_no AS revision, d.execution_id AS executionId, d.affected_node_id AS routingNodeId, d.defect_qty AS defectQty, d.record_action AS recordAction, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(t.action_type AS BINARY(32))=CAST(#{assess} AS BINARY(32)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assessmentCount, MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(t.action_type AS BINARY(32))=CAST(#{assess} AS BINARY(32)) THEN t.attribution_type END) AS attribution, MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(t.action_type AS BINARY(32))=CAST(#{assess} AS BINARY(32)) THEN t.related_declaration_id END) AS relatedDeclarationId, MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(t.action_type AS BINARY(32))=CAST(#{assess} AS BINARY(32)) THEN t.basis END) AS basis, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(t.action_type AS BINARY(32))=CAST(#{returned} AS BINARY(32)) THEN t.returned_qty ELSE 0 END),0) AS returnedQty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(t.action_type AS BINARY(32))=CAST(#{transfer} AS BINARY(32)) THEN t.transfer_qty ELSE 0 END),0) AS transferredQty, SUM(CASE WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL AND ( CAST(t.action_type AS BINARY(32)) NOT IN (CAST(#{assess} AS BINARY(32)),CAST(#{returned} AS BINARY(32)),CAST(#{transfer} AS BINARY(32))) OR CAST(t.declaration_id AS BINARY(128)) != CAST(d.declaration_id AS BINARY(128)) OR t.execution_id != d.execution_id OR t.routing_node_id != d.affected_node_id OR t.returned_qty < 0 OR t.transfer_qty < 0 OR (CAST(t.action_type AS BINARY(32))=CAST(#{assess} AS BINARY(32)) AND (CAST(t.attribution_type AS BINARY(32)) IS NULL OR CAST(t.attribution_type AS BINARY(32)) NOT IN (CAST(#{independent} AS BINARY(32)),CAST(#{overlap} AS BINARY(32))) OR t.basis IS NULL OR (CAST(t.attribution_type AS BINARY(32))=CAST(#{independent} AS BINARY(32)) AND t.related_declaration_id IS NOT NULL) OR (CAST(t.attribution_type AS BINARY(32))=CAST(#{overlap} AS BINARY(32)) AND (t.related_declaration_id IS NULL OR t.related_declaration_id=d.declaration_id)) OR (CAST(t.attribution_type AS BINARY(32))=CAST(#{overlap} AS BINARY(32)) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mes_production_defect related WHERE CAST(related.declaration_id AS BINARY(128))=CAST(t.related_declaration_id AS BINARY(128)) AND related.execution_id=d.execution_id AND related.defect_qty>=d.defect_qty AND CAST(related.record_action AS BINARY(32)) IN (CAST(#{created} AS BINARY(32)),CAST(#{revised} AS BINARY(32))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_production_defect newer_related WHERE newer_related.declaration_id=related.declaration_id AND newer_related.revision_no>related.revision_no) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_quality_treatment assessment WHERE assessment.declaration_id=related.declaration_id AND assessment.declaration_revision=related.revision_no AND CAST(assessment.action_type AS BINARY(32))=CAST(#{assess} AS BINARY(32)))=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_quality_treatment assessment WHERE assessment.declaration_id=related.declaration_id AND assessment.declaration_revision=related.revision_no AND assessment.execution_id=related.execution_id AND assessment.routing_node_id=related.affected_node_id AND CAST(assessment.action_type AS BINARY(32))=CAST(#{assess} AS BINARY(32)) AND CAST(assessment.attribution_type AS BINARY(32))=CAST(#{independent} AS BINARY(32))) )) OR t.returned_qty != 0 OR t.transfer_qty != 0)) OR (CAST(t.action_type AS BINARY(32))=CAST(#{returned} AS BINARY(32)) AND (t.returned_qty <= 0 OR t.transfer_qty != 0)) OR (CAST(t.action_type AS BINARY(32))=CAST(#{transfer} AS BINARY(32)) AND (t.transfer_qty <= 0 OR t.returned_qty != 0)) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalidFacts, SUM(CASE WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL AND CAST(t.action_type AS BINARY(32)) NOT IN (CAST(#{assess} AS BINARY(32)),CAST(#{returned} AS BINARY(32)),CAST(#{transfer} AS BINARY(32))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknownActions FROM mes_production_defect d LEFT JOIN mes_quality_treatment t ON t.declaration_id=d.declaration_id AND t.declaration_revision=d.revision_no WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_production_defect newer WHERE newer.declaration_id=d.declaration_id AND newer.revision_no>d.revision_no)
AND d.execution_id IN #{id} AND CAST(d.record_action AS BINARY(32)) != CAST(#{voided} AS BINARY(32))
AND d.declaration_id=#{declarationId} AND d.id IN #{id} GROUP BY d.id,d.declaration_id,d.revision_no,d.execution_id,d.affected_node_id,d.defect_qty,d.record_action
mapper.select: SELECT identity_value FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('D:',d.declaration_id,':',d.revision_no) AS identity_value FROM mes_production_defect d WHERE d.execution_id=#{executionId} AND CAST(d.record_action AS BINARY(32))!=CAST(#{voided} AS BINARY(32)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_production_defect newer WHERE newer.declaration_id=d.declaration_id AND newer.revision_no>d.revision_no) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('T:',t.id) AS identity_value FROM mes_quality_treatment t WHERE t.execution_id=#{executionId} ) identities ORDER BY CAST(identity_value AS BINARY(128))

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_production_defect d JOIN mes_quality_treatment t ON t.declaration_id=d.declaration_id AND t.declaration_revision=d.revision_no LEFT JOIN () proof ON proof.eventId=t.id WHERE d.execution_id=#{executionId} AND CAST(d.record_action AS BINARY(32))!=CAST(#{voided} AS BINARY(32)) AND t.action_type=#{transfer} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_production_defect newer WHERE newer.declaration_id=d.declaration_id AND newer.revision_no>d.revision_no) AND COALESCE(proof.validCount,0)!=1

SELECT d.declaration_id AS declarationId, w.code AS workorderCode, m.code AS productCode, m.name AS productName, w.status AS workorderStatus, e.status AS executionStatus, w.source AS source, e.batch_no AS batchNo, m.specification AS specification FROM mes_production_defect d LEFT JOIN mes_production_execution e ON e.id=d.execution_id LEFT JOIN workorder w ON w.id=e.workorder_id LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id=e.product_id WHERE d.id IN #{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT t.id AS eventId, SUM(CASE WHEN d.status=#{posted} AND d.document_type IN (#{defectReceipt},#{scrapReceipt}) AND ((d.document_type=#{defectReceipt} AND w.warehouse_type=#{defective}) OR (d.document_type=#{scrapReceipt} AND w.warehouse_type=#{scrap})) AND o.source=#{local} AND w.source=#{local} AND d.source_execution_id IS NULL AND d.source_workorder_id IS NULL AND d.post_request_id=t.id AND d.posted_by=t.operator_user_id AND d.posted_at IS NOT NULL AND l.quantity=t.transfer_qty AND t.transfer_qty>0 AND t.returned_qty=0 AND l.warehouse_id=t.target_warehouse_id AND l.material_id=e.product_id AND l.unit_id=m.unit_id AND a.id=l.stock_action_id AND a.document_line_id=l.id AND a.operation_id=t.id AND a.operation_id=d.post_request_id AND a.execution_id=t.execution_id AND a.action_type=#{otherReceipt} AND a.source_type=#{receiptSource} AND a.source_id=CAST(d.id AS CHAR) AND a.reference_action_id IS NULL AND a.stock_id=l.stock_id AND a.material_id=l.material_id AND a.unit_id=l.unit_id AND a.warehouse_id=l.warehouse_id AND a.quantity_delta=l.quantity AND a.available_delta=l.quantity AND a.quantity_after-a.quantity_before=l.quantity AND a.available_after-a.available_before=l.quantity AND a.operator_user_id=d.posted_by AND a.request_hash=d.post_request_hash AND CAST(a.batch_no AS BINARY(512))=CAST(l.batch_no AS BINARY(512)) AND CAST(l.batch_no AS BINARY(512))=CAST(e.batch_no AS BINARY(512)) AND (a.bin_code=l.bin_code OR (a.bin_code IS NULL AND l.bin_code IS NULL)) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wm_stock_document_line other_line WHERE other_line.document_id=d.id)=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wm_stock_action other_action WHERE other_action.document_line_id=l.id)=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_quality_treatment other_event WHERE other_event.stock_document_id=d.id)=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wm_stock_action reverse_action WHERE reverse_action.reference_action_id=a.id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS validCount FROM mes_quality_treatment t LEFT JOIN wm_stock_document d ON d.id=t.stock_document_id LEFT JOIN wm_stock_document_line l ON l.document_id=d.id LEFT JOIN wm_stock_action a ON a.id=l.stock_action_id LEFT JOIN mes_production_execution e ON e.id=t.execution_id LEFT JOIN workorder o ON o.id=e.workorder_id LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id=e.product_id LEFT JOIN wm_warehouse w ON w.id=t.target_warehouse_id WHERE t.execution_id=#{executionId} AND t.action_type=#{transferWarehouse} GROUP BY t.id
